marc:datafield.marc:subfield: From Marvel Studios comes Doctor Strange, the story of world famous neurosurgeon Dr. Stephen Strange (Benedict Cumberbatch), whose life changes forever after a horrific car accidient rebders his hands useless. When traditional medicine fails him, he travels to the Nepalese enclave of Kamar-Taj in search of a cure, but instead discovers the ancient arts of sorcery and mysticism. Armed with newfound power he is thrust into a multi-dimensional battle against dark forces bent on destroying existence as we know it. He must give up his past and follow his true destiny as the universe's most powerful sorcerer in this spectacular adventure with incredible special effects, irreverent humor and non-stop action.
